description: Java class defining the ClientTransaction entity for Fineract, representing client financial transactions with methods for creation, reversal, and data mapping.

classes.name: ClientTransaction
classes.description: Entity representing a client transaction, including details like amount, date, type, and associated charges.

methods.name: payCharge
methods.description: Static factory method to create a payment charge transaction.

methods.name: waiver
methods.description: Static factory method to create a waiver transaction.

methods.name: toMapData
methods.description: Converts transaction data into a map for accounting module integration.

methods.name: isPayChargeTransaction
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is a pay charge type.

methods.name: isWaiveChargeTransaction
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is a waive charge type.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated client.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount as a Money object.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the transaction.

methods.name: getSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the transaction was submitted.

methods.name: getExternalId
methods.description: Returns the external ID of the transaction.
